messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.70
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.70) has been released at its website (https://rqtl.org) and on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available on CRAN within a few days.

These are small revisions to C/C++ code to handle changes to the next version of R.

Karl Broman
